header.name: PatrixWorld Sampler [ATLASFIX v0.2.7]
header.description: v0.2.7 ATLASFIX — removes 8 sculk-family entries (sculk, sculk_vein, sculk_catalyst/sensor/shrieker top+side) from terrain_texture.json. These blocks have vanilla flipbook animations that expect multi-frame UV atlases; registering them as static textures caused 'invalid atlas index 1 for the expected UV count 1' errors at load. The 64x64 Patrix PNGs remain in textures/blocks/ so they still apply as texture overrides via filename match (engine uses per-pack file presence). All 122 other textures added in v0.2.6 TEXTUREAUDIT remain registered. Total entries: 377.
